title: Verbal Identity / Why voice matters
slide_intent: Treat words as part of identity because what a brand says and how it says it shape people’s impressions.
strategic_value: A consistent voice across social, merchandising and communications can make Burger King recognizable beyond its logo.
demonstration: Two large paragraphs compare brands with people and explain consistency across communication settings.
practical_value: Include voice decisions alongside visual and behavioral decisions when defining identity.
